ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising_edge timing for all clocked processes. It sequences bus_access, transmitter, receiver, IRQ generators, FIFO instances and control/state registers inside the entity.
ports.evidence: process headers (e.g. bus_access, transmitter, receiver) use rising_edge(clk_i) to update registers

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides synchronous reset branch for all clocked processes. It forces initial values in bus_access, transmitter, receiver, IRQs and FIFO control signals when asserted low.
ports.evidence: process headers use if (rstn_i = '0') then to set reset values (bus_access, transmitter, receiver, irq generators)

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Carries bus transaction signals (strobe, rw, addr, data, etc.) into the UART. Its fields are examined to implement register reads/writes and to feed FIFOs and simulation logging.
ports.evidence: bus_access process uses bus_req_i fields to write ctrl fields and tx_fifo.wdata (bus_req_i.stb/rw/addr/data)

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Provides the address bits used to choose control or data registers (addr(2) used). It gates whether writes/reads target control word or data FIFOs.
ports.evidence: bus_access and FIFO read/write conditions check bus_req_i.addr(2) to select control vs data accesses

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Supplies data for bus write operations. Bus_access captures bits to update ctrl fields and tx_fifo.wdata; simulation_transmitter reads low byte for logging.
ports.evidence: bus_access assigns ctrl fields <= bus_req_i.data(...) and tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(...); simulation_transmitter reads bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0)

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Provided as part of the bus_req_t record; not referenced elsewhere in this entity source, so it carries no effect here.
ports.evidence: No occurrence except declaration of bus_req_i record usage

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Used as the transaction valid qualifier. It gates read/write handling, enables FIFO write and simulation logging, and is reflected as bus_rsp_o.ack.
ports.evidence: bus_access uses if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') then to gate reads/writes; tx_fifo.we uses bus_req_i.stb; sim_tx checks bus_req_i.stb

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Selects write versus read paths in bus_access. It's used together with stb and addr to route data into ctrl or to present readback data and to set FIFO we/re signals.
ports.evidence: bus_access branches on bus_req_i.rw to choose write or read behavior; tx_fifo.we and rx_fifo.re depend on bus_req_i.rw

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Provided in the record but not used anywhere in this entity's source; it carries no effect inside this RTL.
ports.evidence: No occurrences besides bus_req_i record declaration and usage of specific fields

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Part of the bus record but not referenced in this entity; it exerts no behaviour here.
ports.evidence: No source occurrences in the provided RTL

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Declared in the bus request record but not used anywhere in this source, so it has no effect here.
ports.evidence: Not referenced in any process or assignment in the entity

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Present in the bus request record but unused in this source; it does not influence logic here.
ports.evidence: No uses in the RTL

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Part of the bus record type; not referenced in the UART implementation, so it has no role here.
ports.evidence: No occurrences outside the record declaration

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Included in the bus record but unused by this entity; it does not affect any behaviour in this source.
ports.evidence: Not referenced in the entity's processes or assignments

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Part of the bus_req record and not used in this UART implementation; it has no effect here.
ports.evidence: No occurrences in the provided source

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Reports acknowledge, error and read data back to the bus master. Its fields are set in the bus_access clocked process from ctrl fields, fifo status, rx data and bus_req_i.stb.
ports.evidence: bus_access process assigns bus_rsp_o.ack/err/data in reset and on rising_edge(clk_i) using ctrl, fifo and bus_req_i.stb

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Reflects bus_req_i.stb back as an acknowledge. It is set each clock in bus_access to the strobe value.
ports.evidence: bus_access: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb inside rising_edge(clk_i)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Constantly driven to '0' inside bus_access during normal operation. It reports no error from the UART logic.
ports.evidence: bus_access sets bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' in rising_edge(clk_i)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Provides register and FIFO status or received data on reads. Individual bits/fields are assigned from ctrl fields, fifo status, rx_engine.over and rx_fifo.rdata inside bus_access.
ports.evidence: bus_access assigns bus_rsp_o.data(...) <= ctrl.* or fifo signals or rx_fifo.rdata depending on bus_req_i.addr and rw

ports.name: clkgen_en_o
ports.functionality: Conveys ctrl.enable combinationally to the outside as the clock generator enable signal. It directly reflects the internal enable control bit.
ports.evidence: concurrent assignment clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable

ports.name: clkgen_i
ports.functionality: Provides multiple phase/clocks; a prescaler index (ctrl.prsc) selects one element which forms uart_clk. It is indexed combinationally to produce uart_clk.
ports.evidence: uart_clk <= clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))) uses clkgen_i indexed by ctrl.prsc

ports.name: uart_txd_o
ports.functionality: Drives the serial TX line continuously from the tx_engine.txd signal. It reflects the transmitter's current output bit combinationally.
ports.evidence: concurrent assignment uart_txd_o <= tx_engine.txd

ports.name: uart_rxd_i
ports.functionality: Feeds the receiver synchronization shift register. It is sampled into rx_engine.sync and thereby drives rx_engine.sreg, done and FIFO write events.
ports.evidence: receiver process assigns rx_engine.sync(2) <= uart_rxd_i and shifts it into sync(1 downto 0)

ports.name: uart_rtsn_o
ports.function: RTS (request to send) output for HW flow control
ports.functionality: Driven from rtr_control sequential logic: when hw flow-control is enabled, it asserts or deasserts based on ctrl.enable and rx_fifo.half; otherwise it is held low. It reports ready/stop to remote CTS input.
ports.evidence: rtr_control process sets uart_rtsn_o in reset and on rising_edge(clk_i) based on ctrl.hwfc_en, ctrl.enable and rx_fifo.half

ports.name: uart_ctsn_i
ports.function: CTS (clear to send) input for HW flow control
ports.functionality: Is sampled into the transmitter CTS shift register each clock to reflect remote readiness; it gates transmitter progression when hwfc_en is active.
ports.evidence: transmitter process: tx_engine.cts <= tx_engine.cts(0) & uart_ctsn_i concatenates uart_ctsn_i into tx_engine.cts

ports.name: irq_rx_o
ports.functionality: Driven in rx_irq_generator process. On each clock it reports IRQ when ctrl.enable and the selected rx IRQ conditions (nempty, half, full) match fifo status.
ports.evidence: rx_irq_generator process assigns irq_rx_o <= ctrl.enable and ((ctrl.irq_rx_nempty and rx_fifo.avail) or ... ) on rising_edge(clk_i)

ports.name: irq_tx_o
ports.functionality: Driven in tx_irq_generator process. It reports TX IRQ when ctrl.enable and the selected tx IRQ conditions (empty, nhalf) based on tx_fifo status are met.
ports.evidence: tx_irq_generator sets irq_tx_o <= ctrl.enable and ((ctrl.irq_tx_empty and (not tx_fifo.avail)) or ... ) on rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: uart_clk
signals.functionality: Carries the selected element of clkgen_i indexed by ctrl.prsc. It is updated combinationally and used as the timing qualifier inside transmitter and receiver processes.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignment uart_clk <= clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc)))

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Holds all UART control bits and fields across clocks. Individual fields are written from bus_req_i.data in bus_access and read elsewhere to control engines and outputs.
signals.evidence: bus_access writes ctrl fields from bus_req_i.data; ctrl fields are read by other processes and concurrent assignments

signals.name: ctrl.enable
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes into ctrl; it gates clock generator output, enables transmit/receive state machines and conditionally clears FIFOs via ctrl.clr_* interactions.
signals.evidence: bus_access sets ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c); ctrl.enable used across processes to gate behavior

signals.name: ctrl.sim_mode
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes combined with SIM_MODE_EN constant; when set it forces FIFO clears and enables the simulation transmitter logging behavior.
role: controls FIFO clears and sim TX
signals.evidence: bus_access sets ctrl.sim_mode <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_sim_en_c) and bool_to_ulogic_f(sim_mode_en_c); tx/rx fifo clear expressions include ctrl.sim_mode

signals.name: ctrl.hwfc_en
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes. When '1', rtr_control uses it to gate uart_rtsn_o decisions and transmitter checks CTS accordingly.
role: gates RTS control and CTS checks
signals.evidence: bus_access assigns ctrl.hwfc_en <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_hwfc_en_c); rtr_control and transmitter reference ctrl.hwfc_en

signals.name: ctrl.prsc
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes as a 3-bit index. It selects which bit of clkgen_i becomes uart_clk, thus tuning transmitter/receiver sampling rate.
signals.evidence: bus_access writes ctrl.prsc <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_prsc2_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c); uart_clk uses ctrl.prsc as index

signals.name: ctrl.baud
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes as a 10-bit reload used to initialize baud counters in tx and rx engines. It determines baud timing when engines reload baudcnt.
signals.evidence: bus_access sets ctrl.baud <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_baud9_c downto ctrl_baud0_c); transmitter/rx reload ctrl.baud into baudcnt

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_nempty
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes. When set, rx_irq_generator includes rx_fifo.avail in IRQ generation under ctrl.enable.
signals.evidence: bus_access assigns ctrl.irq_rx_nempty; rx_irq_generator uses it with rx_fifo.avail to set irq_rx_o

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_half
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes. When set, rx_irq_generator uses rx_fifo.half in its IRQ condition under ctrl.enable.
signals.evidence: bus_access writes ctrl.irq_rx_half; rx_irq_generator uses ctrl.irq_rx_half and rx_fifo.half

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_full
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes. When set, rx_irq_generator considers rx_fifo.free (negated) to assert irq_rx_o while ctrl.enable is set.
signals.evidence: bus_access writes ctrl.irq_rx_full; rx_irq_generator checks ctrl.irq_rx_full and not rx_fifo.free

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_empty
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes. When set, tx_irq_generator asserts irq_tx_o when tx_fifo.avail is false (empty) under ctrl.enable.
signals.evidence: bus_access assigns ctrl.irq_tx_empty; tx_irq_generator uses ctrl.irq_tx_empty with tx_fifo.avail

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes. When set, tx_irq_generator asserts irq_tx_o when tx_fifo.half is false (not half) under ctrl.enable.
signals.evidence: bus_access sets ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf; tx_irq_generator uses ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf and not tx_fifo.half

signals.name: ctrl.clr_rx
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes; it is cleared each clock in bus_access and used in the rx_fifo.clear concurrent assignment to force FIFO clear when set.
signals.evidence: bus_access sets ctrl.clr_rx <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_rx_clr_c) and rx_fifo.clear expression includes ctrl.clr_rx

signals.name: ctrl.clr_tx
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes; used to force tx_fifo.clear via concurrent assignment and cleared each clock in bus_access.
signals.evidence: bus_access sets ctrl.clr_tx; tx_fifo.clear expression includes ctrl.clr_tx

signals.name: tx_engine
signals.functionality: Holds the transmitter FSM state, shift register, counters, done/busy flags, CTS history and output bit across clocks. Updated in the transmitter process and partly by combinational busy assignment.
signals.evidence: transmitter process assigns tx_engine fields; tx_engine.busy/t xd used elsewhere; uart_txd_o <= tx_engine.txd

signals.name: tx_engine.state
signals.functionality: Three-bit state register with state(2) forced to ctrl.enable. Lower bits transition through FSM branches to start, wait for CTS, shift bits and signal done. It steers tx behavior and tx_fifo.re assertion.
signals.evidence: transmitter process sets tx_engine.state bits (state(2) <= ctrl.enable) and case tx_engine.state drives behavior; tx_fifo.re <= '1' when state = "100"

signals.name: tx_engine.sreg
signals.functionality: Loaded from tx_fifo.rdata with stop bit appended and shifted right during transmit bit-timing cycles. It supplies tx_engine.txd and is updated during baud ticks.
signals.evidence: transmitter loads tx_engine.sreg <= tx_fifo.rdata & '0' and shifts sreg on baud expiry; tx_engine.txd <= tx_engine.sreg(0)

signals.name: tx_engine.bitcnt
signals.functionality: Counts down transmitted bits; initialized when transmit starts and decremented each bit-time. When reaching zero it sets done and returns state bits to idle.
signals.evidence: transmitter sets bitcnt <= "1011" and decrements on baud expiry; if bitcnt = "0000" then tx_engine.done <= '1'

signals.name: tx_engine.baudcnt
signals.functionality: Reloaded from ctrl.baud at symbol boundaries and decremented each uart_clk tick to time serial bit shifts. It gates when sreg shifts and bitcnt decrements occur.
signals.evidence: transmitter: tx_engine.baudcnt <= ctrl.baud on entering send; else decremented each uart_clk tick

signals.name: tx_engine.done
signals.functionality: Set to '1' when a frame has completed (bitcnt = 0). It is cleared each clock and used to indicate tx completion; also used as source to other logic possibly.
signals.evidence: transmitter sets tx_engine.done <= '1' when tx_engine.bitcnt = "0000"; tx_fifo.re <= '1' when state = "100"

signals.name: tx_engine.busy
signals.functionality: Combinationally derived from tx_engine.state low bits: busy is '0' when state(1 downto 0) = "00", else '1'. It reports whether transmitter is active.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignment tx_engine.busy <= '0' when (tx_engine.state(1 downto 0) = "00") else '1'

signals.name: tx_engine.cts
signals.functionality: Two-bit shift register capturing uart_ctsn_i each clock; used to filter/check remote CTS state before transmitting when hwfc_en is active.
signals.evidence: transmitter: tx_engine.cts <= tx_engine.cts(0) & uart_ctsn_i (shift) each clock

signals.name: tx_engine.txd
signals.functionality: Holds the bit currently driven onto uart_txd_o; it is set each clock within transmitter (default '1', or sreg(0) during send). The port uart_txd_o directly reflects it.
signals.evidence: transmitter sets tx_engine.txd <= '1' default and tx_engine.txd <= tx_engine.sreg(0) in when "111"; uart_txd_o <= tx_engine.txd

signals.name: rx_engine
signals.functionality: Holds receiver FSM state, shift register, counters, sync bits, done and over flag. Updated in the receiver process and used to write received bytes into rx_fifo.
signals.evidence: receiver process updates rx_engine fields; rx_fifo.wdata <= rx_engine.sreg(7 downto 0); rx_fifo.we <= rx_engine.done

signals.name: rx_engine.state
signals.functionality: Two-bit state register with state(1) set to ctrl.enable. Lower bit controls start/collect phases: detecting start bit through sync and counting bits; transitions orchestrate sreg loading and done flag.
signals.evidence: receiver sets rx_engine.state(1) <= ctrl.enable and case rx_engine.state controls sampling and rx_engine.done

signals.name: rx_engine.sreg
signals.functionality: Shifted in from rx_engine.sync bits at each baud tick and holds received byte plus stop/start as implemented; its low 8 bits are presented to rx_fifo.wdata when a byte is complete (rx_engine.done).
signals.evidence: receiver: rx_engine.sreg <= rx_engine.sync(2) & rx_engine.sreg(... ) when baudcnt expires; rx_fifo.wdata <= rx_engine.sreg(7 downto 0)

signals.name: rx_engine.bitcnt
signals.functionality: Counts down bits being sampled; initialized on start and decremented each baud tick. When zero it sets rx_engine.done to write a byte to the RX FIFO.
signals.evidence: receiver initializes bitcnt <= "1010" and decrements on baud expiry; if bitcnt = "0000" then rx_engine.done <= '1'

signals.name: rx_engine.baudcnt
signals.functionality: Reloaded from ctrl.baud (with one-bit shift for the first sample) and decremented at uart_clk ticks to schedule sampling; drives shifts into sreg and bitcnt decrementing.
signals.evidence: receiver reloads rx_engine.baudcnt <= '0' & ctrl.baud(9 downto 1) on start and decrements on uart_clk

signals.name: rx_engine.done
signals.functionality: Set when a full byte has been received (bitcnt hits zero). It is used to assert rx_fifo.we to push the received byte into the RX FIFO and cleared each clock.
signals.evidence: receiver sets rx_engine.done <= '1' when rx_engine.bitcnt = "0000"; rx_fifo.we <= rx_engine.done

signals.name: rx_engine.sync
signals.functionality: Three-stage synchroniser capturing uart_rxd_i and shifted on uart_clk to produce a filtered sample for the receiver FSM. It supplies bits shifted into rx_engine.sreg.
signals.evidence: receiver: rx_engine.sync(2) <= uart_rxd_i; if (uart_clk = '1') then rx_engine.sync(1 downto 0) <= rx_engine.sync(2 downto 1)

signals.name: rx_engine.over
signals.functionality: Set when an RX FIFO write occurs while FIFO reports no free space. Cleared on reset or when ctrl.enable = '0'. It flags an overrun condition for status reads.
signals.evidence: fifo_overrun process sets rx_engine.over <= '1' when rx_fifo.we = '1' and rx_fifo.free = '0'; cleared when ctrl.enable = '0'

signals.name: rx_fifo
signals.functionality: Aggregate record connected to an instantiated FIFO. Its clear/we/re/wdata are driven here; free/avail/half/rdata are produced by the FIFO instance and used by status/read paths.
role: hosts FIFO control and status signals
signals.evidence: rx_engine_fifo_inst port map connects FIFO outputs to rx_fifo.free/avail/half/rdata; rx_fifo.* controlled/used elsewhere

signals.name: rx_fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Combinationally driven to '1' when ctrl.enable = '0' or ctrl.sim_mode = '1' or ctrl.clr_rx = '1' to clear the RX FIFO; otherwise '0'. Provided to FIFO instance's clear input.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignment rx_fifo.clear <= '1' when (ctrl.enable = '0') or (ctrl.sim_mode = '1') or (ctrl.clr_rx = '1') else '0'; port map clear_i => rx_fifo.clear

signals.name: rx_fifo.we
signals.functionality: Driven by rx_engine.done to enqueue completed received bytes into the instantiated RX FIFO. The FIFO instance consumes this as its write enable.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.we <= rx_engine.done; port map we_i => rx_fifo.we

signals.name: rx_fifo.re
signals.functionality: Asserted combinationally when the bus performs a read to the data register (bus_req_i.stb = '1', rw = '0', addr(2) = '1'), causing the FIFO instance to output the next byte.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.re <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '0') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'; port map re_i => rx_fifo.re

signals.name: rx_fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: Carries the low 8 bits of the receiver shift register to the FIFO write data input when rx_fifo.we is asserted. It is directly sourced from rx_engine.sreg(7 downto 0).
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.wdata <= rx_engine.sreg(7 downto 0); port map wdata_i => rx_fifo.wdata

signals.name: rx_fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: Supplies the FIFO's output data to the bus read path. It is produced by the FIFO instance and used in bus_access to present received byte to bus_rsp_o.data.
signals.evidence: rx_engine_fifo_inst port map rdata_o => rx_fifo.rdata; bus_access reads rx_fifo.rdata into bus_rsp_o.data for data reads

signals.name: rx_fifo.free
signals.functionality: Driven by the FIFO instance to indicate free space. It is used in status readback and to detect overrun conditions when writes occur with no free space.
role: read by status and overrun logic
signals.evidence: rx_engine_fifo_inst maps free_o => rx_fifo.free; used in bus_access and fifo_overrun process

signals.name: rx_fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Driven by the FIFO instance to indicate availability of data. It contributes to status readback signals and RX IRQ generation.
signals.evidence: rx_engine_fifo_inst maps avail_o => rx_fifo.avail; bus_access reads rx_fifo.avail and rx_irq_generator uses it

signals.name: rx_fifo.half
signals.functionality: Provided by FIFO instance; used for status readback and for asserting RTS when half-full if hw flow-control is enabled.
signals.evidence: rx_engine_fifo_inst maps half_o => rx_fifo.half; rtr_control and bus_access reference rx_fifo.half

signals.name: tx_fifo
signals.functionality: Aggregate record connected to the TX FIFO instance. Its control fields are driven by bus writes and transmitter state; its status outputs (free/avail/half/rdata) come from the instance and feed IRQs and status reads.
signals.evidence: tx_engine_fifo_inst port map connects FIFO to tx_fifo.*; tx_fifo.* used for IRQ and transmitter sourcing

signals.name: tx_fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Combinationally asserted when ctrl.enable = '0' or ctrl.sim_mode = '1' or ctrl.clr_tx = '1' to clear the TX FIFO. Provided to the TX FIFO instance clear input.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.clear <= '1' when (ctrl.enable = '0') or (ctrl.sim_mode = '1') or (ctrl.clr_tx = '1') else '0'; port map clear_i => tx_fifo.clear

signals.name: tx_fifo.we
signals.functionality: Asserted combinationally on bus writes to the TX data register (bus_req_i.stb = '1', rw = '1', addr(2) = '1'). Drives the FIFO instance write input to enqueue transmit bytes.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.we <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'; port map we_i => tx_fifo.we

signals.name: tx_fifo.re
signals.functionality: Asserted when the transmitter FSM enters state "100" to fetch a byte for transmission. Drives the FIFO instance to present rdata and adjust level.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.re <= '1' when (tx_engine.state = "100") else '0'; port map re_i => tx_fifo.re

signals.name: tx_fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: Carries the low 8 bits of bus_req_i.data into the TX FIFO on write operations. It is connected to the FIFO instance write data input.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(data_rtx_msb_c downto data_rtx_lsb_c); port map wdata_i => tx_fifo.wdata

signals.name: tx_fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: Provided by the TX FIFO instance; used by the transmitter to load the shift register when starting transmission.
signals.evidence: tx_engine_fifo_inst maps rdata_o => tx_fifo.rdata; transmitter loads tx_engine.sreg <= tx_fifo.rdata & '0'

signals.name: tx_fifo.free
signals.functionality: Driven by the TX FIFO instance to indicate free space; used for status readback and for generating TX IRQ conditions and bus_rsp TX busy indication.
role: read by bus_access and IRQ logic
signals.evidence: tx_engine_fifo_inst maps free_o => tx_fifo.free; bus_access reads tx_fifo.free and tx_irq_generator uses tx_fifo.avail/half to compute irq

signals.name: tx_fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Provided by the FIFO instance; used to compute tx busy status and TX IRQ conditions and to trigger transmitter state transitions when data available.
signals.evidence: tx_engine_fifo_inst maps avail_o => tx_fifo.avail; transmitter checks tx_fifo.avail and bus_access uses it for status

signals.name: tx_fifo.half
signals.functionality: Provided by FIFO instance to indicate half-full threshold. It is used for IRQ generation and status readback.
signals.evidence: tx_engine_fifo_inst maps half_o => tx_fifo.half; bus_access reads tx_fifo.half and tx_irq_generator uses tx_fifo.half
